notes.title: Survivor Cells Update is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/1f69c8bd06a08832c78041f63b8cf868cbc56b65.png[/img]

[b]Survivor Cells[/b] has just received a fantastic update! Get ready to explore all the new features and take your gaming experience to the next level!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/7b2b7db2ffb2784f934334bc9ec7ab5131c748e9.gif[/img]

[b]- New Game Mode: Endless[/b]  
Now you can test your limits in the new [b]Endless[/b] mode! Survive as long as possible against endless waves of enemies in a never-ending gameplay experience. Start the mode already at Year 100 with upgrades purchased in the laboratory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/fc38ae8490b7bc7e1233db916cedded37b50ef42.gif[/img]

[b]- Alchemy Improvements[/b]  
The Alchemy system has been refined, making strategy creation even more dynamic. Adjusting your build during gameplay is now more intuitive and effective!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/ad3a7fe3179e7392b551be77af6dec16efa4cb1d.gif[/img]

[b]- Laboratory Enhancements[/b]  
The Laboratory has been updated to make managing your cells and resources easier, making your decisions more strategic and practical.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/e34e423cf05c1842f9a60f3254041c405ed764bb.gif[/img]

[b]- Various Fixes and Gameplay & Navigation Improvements[/b]  
We’ve implemented numerous fixes and improvements that make gameplay and navigation smoother and more engaging, ensuring a more enjoyable experience.

[b]- New SFX[/b]  
To further enhance your immersion, we've added new sound effects that will make your battles even more exciting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/16cfe50711f9e65f590827764194d75799503578.gif[/img]

Update your game now and enjoy all these improvements!  
Get ready to face new challenges and take your survival to the next level!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1976100/Survivor_Cells/

In this never-ending mode, your goal is to survive as many years as possible, facing increasingly larger and more intense challenges!

Prepare your cells, equip your remedies, and face endless waves of viruses! Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate survival master?

Stay tuned for more updates and get ready for this new limitless adventure!

notes.title: Build Lands Available Now!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42045586/3f4da23ab0da645708d04d1e08a63c5f2fff44c1.gif[/img]

[b]The big day has come guys!!![/b]

We are very excited and happy with the development and Early Access Release of “Build Lands”!

In Build Lands you will relax and have fun building islands or creating your own.
And it doesn't stop there! You'll be able to share the islands you've created in the Workshop so your friends and the community can venture into your creation.

[b]Fun for all ages![/b]

[b]We have a lot of news in this game!!![/b]

[u]Check out some of them!:[/u]

- Build Lands: Game mode in which you will discover and build 20 lands, one cuter than the other. With each level you pass, a new block will be added to your ‘’inventory’’ so that you can use it to create your island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42045586/419422e8229ef615de803051d5c04d631310797f.gif[/img]

- Land Editor: it's where you can use your imagination and creativity to assemble the island of your dreams.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42045586/7a9b085e9bb73a7b351a97b0b550e121d0c3d119.gif[/img]

- Workshop: a place where you will find not only your island but the islands of your friends and people in the community, where you can evaluate them and choose any island you want to have fun assembling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42045586/239f84cfecb41af10c0aa7d32f004ede5fe1fb9b.gif[/img]

- Themed Islands: New types of blocks are on the way to spark your imagination even more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42045586/4a3f16355d99173357ea7c0cfe3385aa3ca3dd2e.gif[/img]

[b]Much more news to come...[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42045586/a000ddbeb1107abb8f9512734baa3253bf62555b.png[/img]

Once again we would like to count on the support of the community to make this game a success, for that we count on your feedback and suggestions!

To facilitate communication beyond the forum here on Steam we are happy to present our official discord, there you can share all your ideas and feedback about the new game and you will know in advance all the news.

[url=https://discord.gg/jACf6GeGBE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42045586/22a206d24fa7159ebb91e45b5a610408a0965769.png[/img][/url]

Don't forget to follow us on the studio's Steam page, so you'll be aware of new games and news from the studio.

We hope you have a lot of fun with the game, it is being made with love!!!

Don't forget to tell us what you think!!!

Thank you one more time!!!
